تشاغلت (form VI)
# تَشَاغَلْتُ (tašāḡaltu) /ta.ʃaː.ɣal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَاغَلَ (tašāḡala)
# تَشَاغَلْتَ (tašāḡalta) /ta.ʃaː.ɣal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَاغَلَ (tašāḡala)
# تَشَاغَلْتِ (tašāḡalti) /ta.ʃaː.ɣal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَاغَلَ (tašāḡala)
# تَشَاغَلَتْ (tašāḡalat) /ta.ʃaː.ɣa.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
